integrity: The determinant factorization and low-degree ranks were checked by exact symbolic computations on supplied code; the analytic infinite-degree proof invokes the classical published Bernstein inequality. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only four regular-tetrahedron vertices and intrinsic tangential gradients, for exactly one spherical harmonic degree at a time. Does not classify perturbations, conditioning, or uniqueness of a harmonic input with more than eight coefficients. The 2026 tangential-kernel work is comparative context, not the founding source. Publication priority is subject to potential unindexed tetrahedral/vector-harmonic tables.
title: A fifth-degree blind spot in tetrahedral tangential harmonic sampling
